title: Error envelope (any command with --json)
description: Printed on stdout for exits 1, 2, 10, 20 and 21 (any command, including wait when the session is forgotten mid-wait), for exit 12 with code schema_newer or failed (any command), and by start for exit 12 with code launch_failed. Not printed by --dry-run, which prints the plan for exits 0, 12 and 20, except exec --session-id --dry-run of a record without a usable launch spec (refused, exit 20, or failed, exit 12).

code.description: usage (exit 2; also an invalid config, with detail), not_found (10), ambiguous (21), refused (20), launch_failed (12; start, a launch-validation failure), failed (12; an operational failure outside a launch, e.g. cron install without crontab, transcript read errors, an unusable, unsafe or foreign state.db; an outcome-file write failure is only a warning), schema_newer (12; the database schema is newer than this claude-session, checked first by every command), internal (1).

reason.description: Refusal reason; required when code is refused (exit 20).

csession_id.description: For launch_failed: the session whose run ended not-started (never null then).

run.description: For launch_failed: the run that ended not-started.

end_reason.description: Launch-validation end_reason; required when code is launch_failed.

hint.description: How to fix the cause (e.g. install command); required (nullable) when code is launch_failed.

detail.description: For failed: what failed (e.g. the operation and errno); for usage: e.g. the config validation error. Never agent text.
